capabilities: Split a note into one note per heading at a chosen level
Split only the section under the heading above the cursor
Merge linked notes back into the source under headings
Choose whether the source keeps a link, an embed, or nothing
Keep front matter, code blocks, and text before the first heading untouched
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README points to Note composer for extracting a selection or merging notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to split a long note into separate notes at each heading and later recombine them, so refactoring large notes means manual copying, pasting, and link fixing.
summary: Note-splitting tool that breaks a note into one note per heading and merges linked notes back into the source.
